purpose: Select an explicitly conditional likelihood after V25 rejected further EDM-loss variants.

gaussian_copula_control.model: V14 observable-conditioned mean/location/Fourier-band scales plus V21 voxel-conditional inverse marginal and a train-only source-balanced four-band Gaussian latent field
gaussian_copula_control.finding: Conditionally correct one-point transforms and band variances do not make the joint latent field Gaussian. Every domain loses high-k and two-point checks, and every Q3/Q4 gate fails. A learned conditional spatial copula is necessary.

coordinate_audit.representation: six-level orthonormal 3-D Haar decomposition of the frozen V21 64^3 conditional-affine latent
coordinate_audit.finding: Haar isolates the sole DC coefficient and exposes a factor-103.5 scale range, so 42 train-only level/channel affine scales are required before a standard-normal base likelihood.

selected_likelihood.name: coarse_to_fine_conditional_haar_rational_quadratic_spline_flow
reason: It provides a normalized proper likelihood on all 64^3-1 stochastic degrees of freedom.
It isolates and fixes DC exactly in the mathematical coordinate system rather than projecting an unconstrained terminal sample.
Its coarse-to-fine factorization conditions fine structure on observables and already generated large-scale latent structure.
Rational-quadratic coupling transforms can learn non-Gaussian spatial dependence and tail contraction that the rejected Gaussian copula cannot.
Sampling is direct and exactly paired to the trained likelihood; no probability-flow ODE, terminal support, or denoising proxy remains.

rejected_alternatives.another_edm_loss_or_mixture: forbidden by the frozen V25 failure classification
rejected_alternatives.posthoc_clipping_or_Ak: not a likelihood and already ruled out by V24 audits
rejected_alternatives.stationary_gaussian_or_student_t_copula: the three-domain Gaussian control fails joint spatial and tail gates by large margins; changing only radial tails does not restore conditional phases
rejected_alternatives.voxel_independent_mixture_likelihood: cannot preserve filament and two-point dependence
rejected_alternatives.autoregressive_voxel_likelihood: exact but requires 262143 serial sampling steps per realization
rejected_alternatives.unconstrained_full_grid_flow: mishandles the exactly fixed DC degree of freedom

feasibility.selection_role: architecture feasibility only; no validation or gate metric was consulted
